problem: Users cannot log into the mobile iPad app and receive 'Device sync transaction record was not found' error
error_message: Error while trying to access the platform. Invalid Configuration: Device sync transaction record was not found.
common_causes: Metadata cache not generated successfully
DBSchema records not active
Sync Processor Scheduler flow not activated
resolution_steps: Verify metadata cache has been generated successfully for the user's profile
Check that all Object Metadata Cache Configuration records are active
Clone and activate the Sync Processor Scheduler flow template
Ensure user has required permission sets (Field Sales Representative or appropriate role-based permission set)
gotchas: The Sync Processor Scheduler flow must be cloned from the template before activation

problem: Non-admin users receive errors 400 or 403 when attempting to log into the iPad app
error_message: Unknown Error. The operation couldn't be completed. (com.platform.RestAPI.ErrorDomain error 400/403)
common_causes: Missing or incorrect permission set assignments
API access not enabled for user
Incorrect Application Version Number in mobile metadata record
Translation Workbench not configured
User not added to Translation Workbench
resolution_steps: Verify user has Field Sales Representative permission set assigned
Enable API access for the user profile
Enable 'View Developer Name' permission
Update Application Version Number to match org version (e.g., 65.0) in mobile metadata record
Add user to Translation Workbench
Verify SOQL filter conditions on DeviceSyncTransactionRecord
gotchas: Application Version Number must exactly match the org version number
Translation Workbench setup is a commonly missed prerequisite

problem: Users see INVALID_FIELD errors for entities like ContentAsset when logging into iPad app
common_causes: DBSchema SOQL queries reference incorrect field API names
Custom fields missing '__c' suffix
Retrieve Related Record option creating invalid queries
resolution_steps: In Admin Console > Sync > Uncheck 'Retrieve Related Record' until patched
Review and correct SOQL queries in DBSchema records
Ensure field names match the actual field API names in the org
Verify that custom fields include '__c' suffix
Regenerate metadata cache after correcting field references
gotchas: The 'Retrieve Related Record' option can cause invalid queries across multiple entities

problem: iPad app crashes every time users open the calendar
common_causes: Known issue in specific app versions during field testing
resolution_steps: Use previous TestFlight build version
Wait for bug fix in subsequent release
Report issue to engineering team with device model and OS version
gotchas: Calendar crashes may be version-specific; check release notes before upgrading

problem: Metadata cache generation fails with storage limit exceeded error
common_causes: Internal storage limit hit even when Data Storage metrics show low usage
Particularly common on demo org instances
resolution_steps: Navigate to Setup > Data Management > Mass Delete Records
Delete old test data, sample records, and unused Device Sync Transactions
Empty Recycle Bin
Retry metadata cache generation
gotchas: Data Storage metrics in Setup may show low usage but internal limits can still be hit
Demo orgs are particularly susceptible to this issue

problem: Metadata cache generation remains stuck in 'New' or 'Validating' status indefinitely
common_causes: Backend processing queue delays
Invalid DBSchema configurations
System load issues
resolution_steps: Wait for validation to complete (can take 15-30 minutes)
Monitor validation status via Setup > Application Test Execution > look for latest run of DbSchemaValidatorTestSuite
If stuck for extended period, abort and retry
Verify all DBSchema records are valid before regenerating
If issue persists, contact support with org ID and timestamp
gotchas: Validation can legitimately take up to 30 minutes; do not abort prematurely

problem: Error when initiating metadata cache for the first time in a new sandbox
error_message: Default MobileAppName is not configured in the org
common_causes: Mobile App Name not configured in Admin Console Application Settings
resolution_steps: Navigate to Admin Console from App Launcher
Click on the Mobile tile
Select Application Settings in left navigation
Enter Mobile App Name (e.g., 'Customer Engagement')
Save configuration
Return to Metadata Cache section and retry generation
gotchas: This is a mandatory first-time setup step for new sandboxes that is easily overlooked

problem: Device sync transactions fail, preventing data from syncing between iPad app and the platform
common_causes: Record locking
Processing timeouts
Heap size exceptions
CPU time limit exceptions
Insufficient user access
Territory realignment
System maintenance
resolution_steps: Review Transactions queue daily in Admin Console
Ensure no transactions remain in 'New' status for more than one day
Instruct users to do full manual sync by selecting 'Sync Database' from gear icon
Schedule a flow to execute batch job at end of day to process failed transactions
For insufficient access failures: grant permissions then retry from Admin Console
Use 'Simulate' option to test without committing actions
gotchas: Many initially failed transactions will succeed during a batch retry run
Always check transaction failure reason before attempting resolution

problem: Configured objects not syncing to iPad application, sync status does not update to Valid
common_causes: Object Metadata Cache Configuration missing for the objects
DBSchema records not active
Validation not completed
Profile not assigned to Object Metadata Cache Configurations
resolution_steps: Verify Object Metadata Cache Configuration exists for the objects
Check that DBSchema records are created and marked as 'Is Active = true'
Ensure validation has completed successfully (status = 'Valid')
Assign profiles to Object Metadata Cache Configurations
Generate new metadata cache for affected user profiles
Check Admin Console > Mobile > Error Log Management for any sync errors
Review Admin Console > Mobile > Synchronization > Transactions for specific entity sync details
gotchas: Custom objects require the full API name including namespace prefix in DBSchema

problem: Customer Engagement package installation fails with Apex recompilation errors
error_message: ApexClass Dependent class is invalid and needs recompilation
common_causes: Pre-existing Apex compilation issues in the target org
resolution_steps: Before installing package, navigate to Setup > Apex Classes
Click 'Compile All Classes' and wait for completion
Retry package installation
If error persists, contact support with Organization ID, User ID, and Package ID
gotchas: Always compile all Apex classes before any managed package installation
This applies to upgrades as well as fresh installs

problem: RSVP Email Address configuration cannot be deployed between environments
error_message: An Apex Class must be specified when creating an Email Service
common_causes: EmailServiceFunction metadata has dependencies that cannot be easily packaged
resolution_steps: Manually configure RSVP Email Address in each environment through the UI
This is a known limitation requiring manual setup per environment
gotchas: There is no automated deployment path for this configuration; it must be done manually in each org

problem: 2GP unlocked package creation fails when depending on the Customer Engagement managed package
error_message: An error occurred while trying to install a package dependency: null
common_causes: Missing or incorrect dependency configuration in sfdx-project.json
Missing required features in project-scratch-def.json
resolution_steps: Verify sfdx-project.json includes correct dependencies with proper version notation
Ensure project-scratch-def.json includes required features (e.g., the platform-specific feature flag for your CRM edition)
Reference the managed package dependency using correct subscriber package version ID (04t)
Contact engineering team if issues persist
gotchas: The scratch-def features array must include the specific feature flag for the platform edition

problem: Certain standard objects (e.g., ProgramEnrollment) not available for 2GP packages
common_causes: Industry Cloud standard objects not all supported in Second-Generation Managed Packages
resolution_steps: Remove unsupported Industry Cloud standard objects from package.xml
Contact Product Management for guidance on which objects are supported in 2GP
Consider alternative approaches for packaging related functionality
gotchas: No official documentation currently lists which objects are supported in 2GP

problem: When iPad goes offline mid-sync, the sync does not resume automatically at next interval
common_causes: Sync operations require continuous connectivity; interruption is expected to cause failure
resolution_steps: Ensure user is back online for sync to resume
Delta sync will automatically resume at next 5-minute interval once connectivity is restored
Manual sync: User can trigger sync from gear icon > 'Sync Database'
gotchas: This is expected behavior, not a bug. All sync operations must complete while online.
Delta sync runs every 5 minutes but only when the device has connectivity

problem: LWC updates pushed by admins do not automatically appear on mobile devices
common_causes: Automatic LWC updates are disabled in current versions
resolution_steps: Users must clear cached metadata from app settings, OR
Perform a fresh login to the app
gotchas: Automatic LWC updates may be enabled in future releases; check release notes

problem: Complex visit records do not sync consistently between iPad app and online database
common_causes: Known limitation with complex multi-attendee visit scenarios
resolution_steps: Simplify visit creation workflow
Avoid complex multi-attendee scenarios until resolved
Monitor Admin Console > Synchronization > Transactions for failed visit syncs
gotchas: Multi-attendee visit scenarios are a known source of sync issues

problem: Account tab shows unexpected error in mobile app, no Object Metadata Cache Config records
error_message: An unexpected error has occurred. Please contact your system administrator.
common_causes: Missing Life Science Configuration Records (DBSchema entities) in the environment
resolution_steps: Deploy the DBSchema metadata from the starter config repository
Run the data_load.sh script to load and activate records
Verify Object Metadata Cache Configuration records are created for Account object
Generate new metadata cache
gotchas: New sandboxes require DBSchema records to be deployed; they are not automatically present

problem: Error when attempting to create a new Visit requiring translation setup
error_message: Please setup and add languages in translation settings before generating translations.
common_causes: Translation Settings not configured in org
Required languages not added or activated
resolution_steps: Navigate to Setup > Translation Settings
Add required languages (at minimum, English)
Ensure languages are enabled and active
Verify user has access to Translation Workbench
Confirm DBSchema records related to translations are Active
Verify user is assigned to proper profile with translation access
gotchas: Translation Workbench must have at least one language configured even for English-only orgs

problem: Inconsistent issues when mobile app is upgraded vs. fresh install
common_causes: Upgrade path may not cleanly migrate local database and cached metadata
resolution_steps: Delete existing app from iPad
Perform fresh install of new app from TestFlight
Do NOT delete the TestFlight application itself
gotchas: Best practice: Always do fresh install rather than upgrade for testing builds

problem: Zip-to-Territory alignment job not creating ObjectTerritory2Association or ProviderAccountTerritoryInfo records
common_causes: TerritoryGeoAssignmentRule.IsActive defaults to false with no UI method to activate
ContactPointAddress missing valid PostalCode
IsTerrAssignmentExcluded set to true
Required permission sets not assigned directly to user
resolution_steps: Verify Healthcare Provider record is created and active
Ensure ContactPointAddress has valid PostalCode
Set IsTerrAssignmentExcluded = false
Assign required permission sets directly to user
Verify TerritoryGeoAssignmentRule is created with correct GeoCode
Manually activate rule through API/developer console if needed
gotchas: TerritoryGeoAssignmentRule defaults to inactive and has no standard UI toggle
Person Account record type must be assigned to the user's profile

problem: Accounts not showing for rep on mobile after territory assignment
common_causes: ProviderAcctTerritoryInfo records missing for the rep's territory
resolution_steps: Run 'Align Account to Territory' batch job from Territory Management Jobs tab
Verify ObjectTerritory2Association records exist for the accounts
gotchas: Territory batch jobs must be run after any territory changes for records to appear on mobile

problem: Territory alignment batch job fails due to duplicate records
common_causes: Duplicate ObjectTerritory2Association records
Invalid territory IDs
resolution_steps: Query for duplicates: SELECT ObjectId, Territory2Id, COUNT(Id) FROM ObjectTerritory2Association GROUP BY ObjectId, Territory2Id HAVING COUNT(Id) > 1
Remove duplicate records
Re-run alignment batch job
gotchas: Duplicate OT2A records are a common source of batch job failures

problem: Affiliation alignment rules not applying correctly
common_causes: Affiliation role picklist values don't match between TerritoryProviderAffiliationAlignmentRule and ProviderAffiliation
resolution_steps: In Setup > Object Manager, ensure affiliation role values exist on both objects with identical names
gotchas: Picklist values must be exact string matches between the two objects

problem: Territory model not active, preventing alignment operations
common_causes: Territory model in Draft or Planning state
resolution_steps: In Setup > Territory Models, activate the model
Only one model can be active at a time
gotchas: Only one territory model can be active at a time

problem: Rep sees wrong accounts after territory change
common_causes: Alignment batch jobs haven't run after territory reassignment
resolution_steps: Run all three alignment jobs (Account, Zip, Brick) for the affected territories
Schedule jobs to run daily during off-hours (e.g., 2 AM)
gotchas: Territory changes are not immediately reflected; batch jobs must run first
Schedule alignment jobs daily to prevent stale ProviderAcctTerritoryInfo records

problem: Visit not saving on mobile due to record type mismatch
common_causes: Record type mismatch between Visit and ProviderVisit objects
resolution_steps: Ensure record type names are identical on both Visit and ProviderVisit objects
Check in Setup > Object Manager
gotchas: Record type names must be exact string matches between Visit and ProviderVisit

problem: Product detailing section missing from visit engagement page
common_causes: Product Detailing not enabled in Admin Console
resolution_steps: Admin Console > Visit Settings > Product Detailing > Enable Product Detailing Enabled = true
Regenerate metadata cache after enabling
gotchas: Metadata cache must be regenerated after enabling Product Detailing

problem: Signature page not appearing during visit completion
common_causes: No ComplianceStatementDefinition records for the Visit module
resolution_steps: Create at least one ComplianceStatementDefinition with Module = 'Visit' and IsActive = true
gotchas: At least one active ComplianceStatementDefinition record is required for signatures to work

problem: Visit not appearing in rep's calendar despite being created
common_causes: Missing Event record linked to the Visit
Rep not assigned to the account's territory
resolution_steps: Check Visit.WhatId links to an Event record
Verify rep's UserTerritory2Association includes the account's territory
gotchas: Visits must be linked to Event records to appear in the calendar

problem: Cannot create visit on mobile, visit not appearing as option
common_causes: Visit object not in DB Schema
Quick Action not configured for visit creation
resolution_steps: Check DB Schema for Visit object and ensure it is active
Check Quick Actions for NewVisit action
Regenerate metadata cache
gotchas: Both DB Schema and Quick Action configuration are required for mobile visit creation

problem: Visit sync error on iPad, visits fail to sync
common_causes: DB Schema SOQL filter on Visit is invalid
Visit trigger handler is inactive
resolution_steps: Check DB Schema for Visit WhereSoql filter validity
Check trigger handlers for VisitTriggerHandler and ensure it is active
gotchas: Invalid SOQL filters in DB Schema can silently prevent sync

problem: Sample limit shows exceeded but should not be
common_causes: ProviderSampleLimit QuantityDisbursed not reset for new time period
Wrong TimePeriod associated with the limit
resolution_steps: Check TimePeriod dates and ensure correct period is associated
Run Sample Limits batch job to regenerate limits for the current period
gotchas: TimePeriod records must exist for each active period; limits do not auto-reset

problem: Product not appearing in sample drop during visit
common_causes: Product not active (Product2.IsActive = false)
Product not assigned to rep's territory
Product not in DB Schema
resolution_steps: Check Product2.IsActive = true
Verify product-to-territory assignment
Check DB Schema for Product2 and InventoryOperation objects
gotchas: All three conditions must be met for a product to appear in the sample drop

problem: Inventory count mismatch between system and physical inventory
common_causes: ProductItem records out of sync after manual adjustments
resolution_steps: Run inventory reconciliation
Query ProductItem for the location and verify counts match physical inventory
gotchas: Manual adjustments outside the standard workflow can cause persistent mismatches

problem: Cannot disburse samples on mobile device
common_causes: Sample-related objects missing from DB Schema
SampleTriggerHandler inactive
resolution_steps: Check DB Schema for ProductDisbursement, ProviderSampleLimit, ProductItem
Check trigger handler status for SampleTriggerHandler
gotchas: Multiple DB Schema records and trigger handlers must all be active for sample disbursement

problem: Sample limit batch job not generating limits for current period
common_causes: Missing TimePeriod records for the current period
Products not associated with limit templates
resolution_steps: Verify TimePeriod records exist for the current period
Check sample limit template product assignments in Admin Console
gotchas: TimePeriod records must be created manually for each period before the batch job will work

problem: System Administrator cannot log into the iPad app while Sales Reps can
common_causes: System Admin profiles are not designed for the mobile sync model, which has a local database that cannot fit an entire org's data
resolution_steps: This is by design - System Admin profiles are not configured for the mobile sync model
Configure appropriate field sales profiles with the correct metadata cache configuration
gotchas: This is an architectural design choice, not a bug. The iPad app's local database cannot hold an entire org.

problem: Calendar and Planner tabs not appearing on iPad despite working on desktop
common_causes: Missing permission set assignments
Metadata cache not synchronized with mobile device
Missing profile options in configuration records
resolution_steps: Verify all recommended permission sets are assigned
Create and synchronize metadata cache with the mobile device
Check for any missing profile options in configuration records
Validate that required licenses and feature flags are enabled
gotchas: Features working on desktop do not automatically appear on mobile; separate configuration is needed

problem: Open Activities Related List renders on web but not on iPad
common_causes: Standard Open Activities related list is not supported on iPad; requires platform-specific component
resolution_steps: Use the platform-specific 'Related List' component with proper field sets and metadata cache
Create field set on Task object
Add component to Lightning page using Tabs component
Configure Object Metadata Cache Configuration for Tasks
Generate and activate new cache, then sync iPad
gotchas: Standard related lists may not work on mobile; use the platform-specific related list component

problem: Visit dates showing incorrectly (e.g., Jan 23 showing as Jan 24)
common_causes: Timezone mismatch between demo environment and iPad settings
resolution_steps: Set iPad timezone to match the org timezone
May need to force resync by deleting and reinstalling the app
gotchas: Timezone mismatches can cause dates to appear off by one day

problem: Account creation and search failures with HCO filters
common_causes: Record Type mapping configuration issues
Field-level security settings incorrect
Address Type picklist showing all values instead of respecting Record Type mapping
resolution_steps: Verify Record Type mapping configuration
Check field-level security settings
Review picklist value dependencies on Record Types
gotchas: Address Type picklist values are controlled by Record Type mapping, not just field-level security

problem: Creating Staff records via Advanced Search on iPad fails silently
common_causes: Desktop validation rules (e.g., Provider Specialty) not firing or displaying errors on iPad
resolution_steps: Review validation rules and ensure they are properly configured for mobile context
gotchas: Validation rules may behave differently on mobile vs. desktop; test on both platforms

problem: Blank screen when testing Visit Type Mapping on desktop
common_causes: Permission or caching issue
resolution_steps: Upload HAR files for investigation
Clear browser cache
Try a different browser
gotchas: Check browser console for 403 errors which indicate permission issues rather than configuration problems

problem: iPad device compatibility and requirements
common_causes: Older iPads or unsupported OS versions
resolution_steps: Use 8th Gen iPad or later
Update device to iPadOS 18.x
For macOS: Must be Apple Silicon, not Intel
iPad Pro 11-inch M3/M4 processor with 8GB RAM recommended for demos
gotchas: Intel-based Macs are not supported for the macOS version of the mobile app

problem: Login issues on iPad via Safari browser, redirected to 'It's better in the app' page
common_causes: Safari not configured for desktop website mode
resolution_steps: Open Settings > Safari > Request Desktop Website > Edit
Clear all existing sites that were manually entered
Enable for 'All Websites'
Turn off: Block All Cookies, Prevent Cross-Site Tracking, Private Browsing, Block Pop-ups
Use latest stable version of iPadOS
gotchas: Lightning Experience on iPad Safari is only supported in desktop websites mode

problem: Remote Engagement with Microsoft Teams setup is complex and time-consuming
common_causes: Requires Azure App Registration and External Auth Identity Provider configuration
Special org permission must be enabled
resolution_steps: Ensure org permission for MS Teams Pilot is added (not a standard license setting)
Obtain Microsoft license
Complete Azure App Registration setup
Configure External Auth Identity Provider
gotchas: The org permission must be specifically requested and enabled; it is not part of standard licensing
